text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Sniff, sniff... Hmm, this scent... I see. 
Boss, are you hiding something from me?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It weighs heavily on your chest, a worry 
that hasn't left your mind lately—am I 
right?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
*Sniff sniff*... Your heart is opening up, 
isn't it? That's right, I'm on the Boss's 
side, sir.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, why don't you have some 
coffee and take your time telling me about 
it? I shall assist you with all my heart 
and soul!
